questions.explanation:
When n resistance of r ohm connected in parallel then their equivalent resistance is

⇒1R=1r+1r+1r+………n times 
∴1R=nr
⇒R=rn⇒r=nR
When these resistance connected in series

Rs=r+r+…………n times =nr=n×nR=n2R
